item.title: Admissions 2027: Ph.D. in Social Complexity Sciences
item.description: Interdisciplinary training to understand human behavior in society. Applications are open for the Ph.D. in Social Complexity Sciences at the School of Government of Universidad del Desarrollo, the program to which several PoliCICS members belong. Application deadline: September 30 Classes start: March 2027 Format: on campus To learn how to join PoliCICS as a Ph.D. student, write to us through the Contact page.

item.title: Francisco Villarroel on Radio Universidad de Chile: Why do authoritarian leaderships advance?
item.description: Francisco Villarroel, a Ph.D. student in Social Complexity Sciences and a member of PoliCICS, was interviewed on the program La Vuelta al Mundo, on Radio Universidad de Chile, about the question “¿Por qué avanzan los liderazgos autoritarios?” (Why do authoritarian leaderships advance?). His doctoral dissertation studies leadership, social norms, and antisocial behavior. Listen to the full interview on YouTube (in Spanish): youtu.be/ngmXb09Xn-Y
